# dataiku_connection (Data Source)

Reads a single Dataiku DSS connection by name. Requires an API key with admin rights.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataiku_connection" "warehouse" {
  name = "warehouse"
}

output "warehouse_type" {
  value = data.dataiku_connection.warehouse.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the connection to read.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_groups` (List of String) Groups allowed to use the connection.
- `description` (String) Description of the connection.
- `id` (String) The connection name.
- `params_json` (String, Sensitive) Connection parameters as a JSON object. DSS redacts secret fields, so passwords and keys are not readable through this attribute.
- `type` (String) Connection type, for example `PostgreSQL` or `S3`.
- `usable_by` (String) Who may use the connection, `ALL` or `ALLOWED`.
